importHint: Set the genre for each folder so your library is easy to search later. Use Set style on any folder that holds a single genre — e.g. a Vals or Milonga folder — and it applies to everything inside it. Any folder you leave unset stays Mixed: its songs take their style from their own genre tag where they have one (set Mixed yourself to ignore the tags). Toggle Cortina to mark a folder of floor-clearers (kept separate from genre).
retypeHint: Pick a style for each folder using the Set style button on the right, or toggle Cortina to mark a folder of floor-clearers. Both apply to every folder inside — click a subfolder to override.
